name: Packaging Support Group
old_description: At PSG, we believe in a new kind of packaging company. Instead of offering only one piece of the packaging puzzle, we decided to focus on handling whatever our customers need to get their products ready and on the shelf.
about:
Packaging Support Group (PSG) operates from Jonesboro, Arkansas, where it runs a packaging distribution business from a facility on West Johnson Avenue. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website describes a mission to become “a new kind of packaging company” that handles every piece of the packaging puzzle so customers can get products ready for the shelf.

PSG stocks and supplies a wide range of packaging components—glass bottles and jars, plastic containers (PET, HDPE), metal and plastic closures, and industrial containers. It also offers global procurement and warehousing services, managing inventory for clients through an e‑commerce platform that lists hundreds of SKUs organized into collections such as the Stout Family, candle jars, honey containers, and food‑grade pails.

The distributor serves makers of candles, honey, food and beverage products, and general industrial packagers. Its product catalog includes specific lines for candle vessels, honey bottles, and food‑grade plastic pails, indicating a focus on small‑to‑mid‑scale consumer‑goods brands.

PSG positions itself as a “Distributor for the Modern World,” emphasizing a one‑stop approach that combines product sourcing, stock availability, and logistics support rather than selling a single packaging category.
